title: Orange County Deputies Shoot Man Charging at Them With a Knife
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Orange County, Florida — On September 21, 2024, at about 4:30 a.m., The Orange County Sheriff's Office received a 911 call from a woman who said her boyfriend – a man in his 40s - had a knife. Deputies arrived at the In Town Suites at 1951 Central Florida Parkway moments later and encountered the man, who had a knife. The man went back into his room, and the deputies were in the parking lot attempting to get him to come out without the knife so they could get him the help he needed. After about 20 minutes, the man came out, holding the knife above his head, and running toward the deputies, who fired their service weapons, striking the man. Deputies immediately rendered aid until the fire department arrived on scene and transported the man to the hospital, where he was later pronounced dead.
